text:
harper: quick sync on roles matrix v4 1 - in compact view the SSO toggle sits in the top-right and we hide the assign toggle per-role. users are confused why chips look clickable.
olga: saw a support thread this morning. users try to click a disabled role expecting to change perms. we should give clearer affordance or an action path.
rafi: proposal: keep chips visually consistent but show a subtle overlay label 'SSO managed' and make chips `aria-disabled`. clicking a chip should open a small slide-over explaining why it's managed and link to audit.
dev: slide-over is heavier than deep-link. for MVP deep-link to `/audit?filter=role:Admin` is easiest. engineering prefers non-modal flows first.
a11y-bot: scan: compact-roles-frame - low contrast on overlay label; disabled chips removed from tab order. Recommend `aria-disabled="true"` and maintain focusability for the slide-over trigger for screen reader users. Do not rely on color alone.
harper: alternative lighter pattern: show a tiny chevron on hover that reveals 'View audit' as an action. keeps UI tidy and gives a path. thoughts?
olga: chevron + action only on hover is bad for keyboard users. any action must be keyboard discoverable.
rafi: ok compromise: always render a low-contrast link 'View audit' beneath the grid for selected role(s). chips remain non-interactive but have `aria-describedby` to explain. clicking link deep-links to audit filtered by selection.
dev: implementing aggregated audit link is trivial. need product copy for link + tooltip. also need to confirm behavior when multiple roles selected.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) disabled chips use `aria-disabled` not `disabled` attribute. 2) provide `aria-describedby` pointing to explanatory text. 3) audit link must have descriptive `aria-label` with role names or say "selected roles" when multiple. 4) ensure contrast of overlay label >= 4.5:1.
harper: copy drafts: tooltip: "Role assignments managed by your identity provider. Contact your admin." audit link: "View audit history for selected roles" / singular: "View audit history for role Admin" overlay label: "SSO managed".
olga: +1. let's avoid modal this cycle. we can revisit slide-over next quarter.
dev: timeline: we'll implement audit deep-link and aria props next sprint once copy is finalized. I'll add unit tests to assert query params include `role` values.
rafi: i'll update figma frames with the aggregated link and visible helper text for keyboard users.
a11y-bot: final auto-check: ensure `title` not used as sole tooltip; use accessible tooltip pattern and document focus management.
